pool.text: Gassy Jack opened a makeshift tavern on Hastings Mill property
Site selected as terminus for Canadian Pacific Railway
Great Vancouver Fire razed the entire city on June 13
Canadian Pacific transcontinental railway extended to Vancouver
Charles Woodward opened first Woodward's store at Abbott and Cordova
Gothic-style Christ Church Cathedral opened
Vancouver absorbed South Vancouver and Point Grey municipalities
Unemployed men flooded city protesting relief camp conditions
City Hall designed by Townley and Matheson completed
The 556-room Hotel Vancouver opened
RCAF Station Jericho Beach taken over by Canadian Army
Vancouver hosted the Commonwealth Games
Greenpeace founded in Vancouver
Jericho Beach base facilities transferred to City of Vancouver, renamed Jericho Park
Vancouver Canucks began playing in the NHL
Global Relay Gastown Grand Prix held each summer on Gastown cobblestones
Visible minority population reached approximately 24 percent
The Globe and Mail began a national edition in British Columbia
Prime Minister called Vancouver's housing crisis extreme
$3.6 billion spent on film production in Vancouver
